_source: Five Parsecs From Home: Planetfall, printed pp.87-88 (Colony Integrity Failure, Integrity Failure table, Emergency Repairs). Extracted 2026-10-27 from docs/rules/planetfall_source.txt markers PAGE 89-90 (marker = printed + 2).
rule: In the Colony Integrity step, if Integrity is -3 or worse, roll 3D6. If the roll is equal to or below the negative Integrity score flipped (Integrity -8 is treated as 8), you suffer an Integrity Failure: consult the score on the table. Integrity of -1 or -2 has no risk.
emergency_repairs: If you are required to roll on this table, you may spend 1 Story Point to avoid doing so. This does not change the underlying situation.

entries.text: Reduce available Build and Research points next turn by 2 each.
3 Colony Damage. This can be mitigated normally.
A random character on your roster must make an injury roll (see page 66); treat "Death" as 5 turns of recovery instead.
Reduce available Build points next turn by 5. This only affects points earned, not any stored or already spent.
Reduce available Research points next turn by 5. This only affects points earned, not any stored or already spent.
4 Colony Damage. This can be mitigated normally.
5 Colony Damage. This can be mitigated normally.
A random character on your roster must make an injury roll (see page 66).
5 Colony Damage. This cannot be mitigated.
A random character on your roster must make an injury roll (see page 66).
A random character on your roster is slain.
